title: Open a session input
description: Open a named session for a client. Runs submitted into it are listed and streamed together.

sdc.daemon.ClientLabel.title: ClientLabel
sdc.daemon.ClientLabel.description: A label the client gives when it opens a session: free text, at most 200 characters, for display. It grants nothing: who may call is decided by the bearer token alone, and the token's subject is not a member of any entity.

sdc.daemon.SessionId.title: SessionId
sdc.daemon.SessionId.description: The name of a session, chosen by the client that opens it.
